title: Egyptian Solar Energy Dataset (ESED) v1.0: Multi-Year Climate and Equipment Data for Solar System Design
description: Comprehensive multi-year climate and equipment dataset for solar photovoltaic research in Egypt. Contains 341,991 daily climate records across 119 Egyptian locations (2018-2026) from NASA POWER, enriched with K-Means dust-risk scores (4 zones: low, medium, high, extreme). Includes solar panel and inverter equipment catalogues (8 + 7 models), EEHC August 2024 residential and commercial tariff schedules, net-metering regulations, and 5-city PVWatts v5 validation results. Released alongside the Shamsi Smart multi-model AI framework (CNN-LSTM + NSGA-II + YOLOv8) described in the accompanying paper (Applied Energy, under review).
notes: Climate data sourced from NASA POWER API v2 (public domain). Value-added features (dust_zone, dust_risk_score) are original contributions released under CC BY 4.0. Equipment prices are market estimates Q1 2025. EEHC tariff derived from public regulatory documents.
